items.title: Narrow breadth meeting negative dealer gamma into the pre-open
items.note: Market breadth has slipped below its broad-market threshold (heatmap 56.47% positive vs 60%, margin -3.53, narrow) at the same time SPY dealer gamma is negative (signedNetGEX -$2.082B, spot 770.56 below the 774.93 flip) and the prior intraday tape closed as a down trend-day auction (VWAP 771.69) — thinning participation meeting amplifying dealer hedging while the bench still reads bull-stacked (SPY 770.56, +9.89% vs 200d) and the regime is calm (band 'VIX 15.4', VIX 15.41). Structurally this is a fragile-internals / break-watch backdrop into the open rather than a calm broad advance; it is an emergent cross-tool divergence, not any single owner read.
items.method: Cross-tool divergence flag: compare market-heatmap-lab breadthPct against its own 60% broad threshold (sign of the margin), then overlay the options-structure / gamma-trading dealer-gamma sign together with spot-versus-flip position and the intraday-tape session type. Raise the pattern only when breadth is below threshold AND dealer gamma is negative AND the most recent completed intraday auction is directional-down, all against a calm VIX band and a bull-stacked bench.
inputs: market-heatmap-lab: breadthPct 56.47, threshold 60, margin -3.53, 134 constituents, leadership narrow
options-structure-lab: signedNetGEX -2081556088.2129, flipLevel 774.93, spot 770.56, callWall 773, putWall 770
gamma-trading-lab: regime negative, scenario range-break-watch, flip 774.93
intraday-tape-lab: sessionType 'Trend day · down', control Mixed, vwap 771.69, gapPct 0.19
regime band 'VIX 15.4' (vix 15.41, score 0); bench SPY 770.56 bull-stack (+3.11% vs 50d, +9.89% vs 200d)
